name: query_filter_index_unused
description: Performance regression from ignoring prebuilt index and scanning all records linearly

variants.name: exact_evidence
variants.description: Provides profiling data showing full list scans despite index

ground_truth.root_cause: Index is built but not used: extracts all 50k records from index then scans linearly through them for each filter
ground_truth.fix_strategy: Use index lookups: for category/status filters, fetch only matching subset from index[by_category][value] or index[by_status][value]
ground_truth.expected_speedup: ~15% faster (from ~0.072s to ~0.058s) by avoiding full list scans
